description: A real fluffy cat lying on a wooden table, yawning dramatically. Cast as the bored waiter or relieved teammate; useful for a slow before-state or a payoff, not an unrelated cutaway.
author: Lemon tart

description: A real wide-eyed ginger kitten holding an orange rubber rugby ball. Cast as the eager teammate ready to act or move a task forward. Portrait photo; its face also works as a travelling character in a diagram.
author: Aiaikz

description: A real gray cat wearing bright yellow round sunglasses. Confident, unbothered, ship-it energy; a strong payoff or competent new-state character. Portrait photo with a large expressive face.
author: Raoul Droog

description: A real wide-eyed tabby on white stairs, looking curiously at the camera with its head slightly tilted. Cast as the investigator, puzzled user or teammate discovering a gotcha. Tall portrait; face close-up keeps the reaction readable.
author: Alexander London

description: A real black-and-white cat resting both front paws on a bookshelf, staring straight ahead with green eyes. A skeptical reviewer, watchful guard or hold-on-a-minute reaction. Keep the paws in a portrait shot for its deadpan personality.
author: Manja Vitolic

description: A real wide-eyed tabby lying under cardboard and chewing its corner. Mischievous edge-case tester, bug hunter or chaotic before-state character. Wide landscape crop includes the cardboard so the visual joke makes sense.
author: Sindugab

description: A real black-and-white cat curled on a floor with its face, folded paws and pink toe beans visible. Cozy relief, calmer after-state or an off-duty teammate once the confusing work is gone. Wide close crop.
author: N1kos.a98

description: Two real dark-and-ginger kittens cuddled together on a chair. Cast the pair as collaborators, two independent signals that can coexist, or a reassuring together-at-last payoff. A tight wide crop keeps both kittens visible.
author: Jeromi Mikhael
